Intra)sonic The longitudinal   mechanical waves having

Ultuasonic The longitudinal  mechanical waves having
frequencies greater than 20000 Hz are called ultrasonic waves_ Human ear
cannot detect these waves. But certain creatures like dog,cat,bat,mosquito
can detect these waves Bat not only detect but also produce ultrasonic
Ultrasonic Waves can be produced by Galton'$ whistle or Hartman's
generator or by the high trequency vibrations of a quartz crystal under an
alternating electric field Piezo electric effect) or by the vibrations of
ferromagnetic rod under an alternating magnetic field (Magnetostriction)
Applications of Ultrasonic Waves
For sending signals
For measuring the depth of sea:
For cleaning cloths, aeroplanes and machinery parts of clocks_
For removing lamp-shoot from the chimney of factories.
In sterilizing of a liquid_
